completeness.reason: All public API is covered: New, NewWithTime, FromString, NilID, ID methods (String, Time, Machine, Pid, Counter, Bytes, Encode, Compare, Value, Scan, IsNil, IsZero), package-level Sort and FromBytes. The XID_MACHINE_ID environment variable override and panic conditions are described. The Additional Behavioral Constraints section covers NilID.String(), Encode matching String, Value/Scan roundtrip, Scan invalid charset error, FromBytes empty error, Sort empty/single, NilID.Counter, and Compare with NilID.

unambiguity.reason: The 20-char base32 encoding, NilID string as '00000000000000000000', XID_MACHINE_ID range [0, 16777215] with panic on invalid, Scan error for characters outside [0-9a-v], FromBytes([]) error, Compare returning -1 for NilID vs non-nil are all precisely stated. Encode writing same bytes as String is explicit. One minor gap: the base32hex charset is specified for Scan validation but not explicitly for String output consistency.

testability.reason: All blackbox tests map directly to stated constraints: 20-char string, valid base32 chars only, uniqueness, NewWithTime time extraction, Machine 3 bytes, Pid/Counter fields, FromString roundtrip, NilID '00000000000000000000', Encode == String, Value/Scan roundtrip, Scan invalid chars error, FromBytes empty error, Sort empty/single, Compare with NilID. The test_edge_cases_test.go scenarios are all explicitly addressed.

consistency.reason: All described behaviors match xid's actual implementation. Module path (github.com/rs/xid), 12-byte binary structure, 20-char base32 string, machine ID range, and NilID string are accurate. No contradictions.
